draft:
We teach the creed before the water, and you say it back before we baptize you [[lpc.term.catechesis]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We tell you what you are joining before you join it [[lpc.term.catechesis]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Augustine wrote a guide to this teaching of those preparing for baptism [[lpc.term.catechesis]] [[as:paraphrase]].

The works written for those preparing for baptism are about forming believers, and forming believers is the stated aim of both bishops' preaching [[lpc.gravity.preaching-and-catechesis]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Preaching was the bishop's regular talk to the whole gathered church, the baptized and those still learning [[lpc.term.preaching]] [[as:paraphrase]].
